tv_engineering_department.9001 = {
	type = country_event
	title = tv_wonder_ownership.900.t
	desc = tv_wonder_ownership.900.d
	image = "gfx/interface/icons/towards_victory/wonders/tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_cropped.dds"
	outcome = negative

	immediate = {
		# Run before the option renders so the ritual benefit is already gone.
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = 1 }
		tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder } }
			remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_blessing_modifier
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
	}

	option = {
		name = tv_wonder_ownership.900.a
	}
}

	desc = tv_wonder_ownership.900.d
	image = "gfx/interface/icons/towards_victory/wonders/tv_wonder_unique_santa_maria_del_fiore_cropped.dds"
	outcome = negative

	immediate = {
		# Run before the option renders so the ritual benefit is already gone.
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = 153 }
		tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder } }
			remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_unique_santa_maria_del_fiore_ceremony_modifier
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed target = 153 }
				}
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed key = 153 }
			}
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
	}

	option = {
		name = tv_wonder_ownership.900.a
	}
